clusters.name: Arid / High Thermal Stress
clusters.description: Sparse vegetation cover, low moisture retention, peak summer thermal irradiance.

clusters.name: Moderate Cover / Transitional Thermal
clusters.description: Intermediate vegetative greenness and moderate surface temperature during autumn/spring transition.

interpretation_note: Clusters represent joint vegetative greenness and thermal environmental regimes across the phenological cycle, not ecological species biodiversity.
